ADV. RAVI BRIJESH DUBEY

SENIOR LEGAL EXECUTIVE | COMMERCIAL CONTRACTS | CONTRACT DRAFTING & NEGOTIATION |
LEGAL RISK MANAGEMENT

Mumbai, India | [meetrkd@gmail.com](mailto:meetrkd@gmail.com) | +91 8625962865

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Legal Executive and Advocate with 7.2+ years of experience in commercial contracts, contract
lifecycle management, legal risk management, litigation, compliance and corporate legal operations.
Currently working as Senior Legal Executive at AGD Biomedicals Pvt. Ltd., independently handling a
broad portfolio of legal matters and providing legal and commercial support to management and
cross-functional business teams.

Experienced in drafting, reviewing, negotiating and finalising Service Agreements, Vendor
Agreements, Distributor Agreements, OEM Agreements, NDAs, Consulting Agreements, Technology
Transfer Agreements, Tripartite Agreements, Tender Contracts, Rental/Reagent Agreements,
Amendments and other commercial arrangements. Strong exposure to indemnity, limitation of
liability, confidentiality, IP, termination, payment terms, warranties, penalties, performance
obligations, dispute resolution, governing law and jurisdiction.

Commercially oriented legal professional with the ability to translate legal risks into practical financial,
operational and business implications, understand stakeholder requirements and develop workable
risk-mitigation solutions aligned with business objectives and company policies. Experienced in
working with Business Heads, Sales, Procurement, Finance, HR, Operations, Tender, Regulatory,
Quality, vendors, distributors, consultants and external counsel.

Target Roles: Specialist – Contracts | Contracts Specialist | Commercial Contracts | Legal Counsel –
Contracts | Senior Legal Executive – Contracts | Legal Manager | Assistant Legal Manager

CORE COMPETENCIES
Commercial Contracts: Contract Drafting & Review | Contract Negotiation | Contract Lifecycle
Management | Contract Finalisation & Execution | Vendor/Supplier Agreements | Distributor &
Channel Partner Agreements | Service & Consulting Agreements | OEM Agreements | Customer
Agreements | NDAs | Technology Transfer Agreements | Tripartite Agreements | Tender Contracts |
Amendments & Addendam.

Legal Risk & Advisory: Commercial & Legal Risk Assessment | Indemnity | Limitation of Liability |
Confidentiality | Intellectual Property | Termination | Payment Terms | Warranties | Penalties &
Liquidated Damages | Performance Obligations | Dispute Resolution | Arbitration | Governing Law |
Jurisdiction | Contractual Compliance | Risk Mitigation.

Legal Operations: Litigation Management | Legal Notices | Regulatory Compliance | Corporate
Documentation | Board Resolutions | External Counsel Management | Legal Research | Legal
Opinions | Due Diligence | Stakeholder Management | Business Advisory | Cross-functional
Coordination.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AGD BIOMEDICALS PVT. LTD., MUMBAI
Senior Legal Executive | Mar 2024 – Present

Independently manage the end-to-end legal and contract lifecycle, from understanding business
requirements and drafting/reviewing agreements through negotiation, revision, internal approval,
finalisation, execution and monitoring of contractual obligations. Serve as a key legal point of contact
for management and cross-functional teams and provide practical legal and commercial advice across
contracts, tenders, disputes, compliance, employment matters, IP and corporate documentation.



Draft, review, vet and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements including Service
Agreements, Vendor Agreements, Distributor Agreements, OEM Agreements, NDAs, Consulting
Agreements, Technology Transfer Agreements, Tripartite Agreements, Tender Contracts,
Rental/Reagent Agreements and Amendments/Addendam. Regularly negotiate indemnity,
limitation of liability, confidentiality, IP protection, termination, payment obligations, warranties,
penalties, liquidated damages, performance obligations, dispute resolution, governing law and
jurisdiction.

Work closely with Business Heads, Sales, Procurement, Finance, HR, Operations, Tender, Regulatory
and Quality teams** to understand commercial requirements and convert business objectives into
legally appropriate contractual structures. Identify legal, commercial, financial and operational risks
and explain them to stakeholders in practical business terms, while developing mutually workable
alternatives that balance commercial objectives, risk exposure and company policies.

Handle distributor and channel-partner documentation, including appointment terms, performance
obligations, commercial protections, recovery provisions, termination rights and contractual
compliance requirements. Support distributor appointment controls and execution formalities,
including documentation, stamp-paper requirements and contractual completion before operational
processing.

Review government and institutional tender documentation, particularly provisions relating to
eligibility, indemnity, penalties, performance obligations, liquidated damages, debarment/blacklisting,
termination, liability and contractual remedies. Handle and review commercial arrangements
involving reagent rental/instrument placement, minimum purchase or consumption commitments
and related customer obligations, and draft/review tripartite arrangements connected with tender
and commercial transactions.

Support international transactions involving overseas counterparties, including NDAs and technology-
transfer documentation, with particular attention to confidentiality, IP protection, governing law,
contractual risk and execution/stamping requirements. Also support trademark/IP matters, including
documentation and coordination relating to trademark opposition.

Manage and coordinate litigation and pre-litigation matters across India, including consumer disputes,
labour and employment matters, Section 138 NI Act/recovery matters, contractual disputes,
civil/criminal proceedings and regulatory issues. Coordinate with external advocates, senior counsel,
courts, tribunals and government authorities for filings, hearings, documentation and case
management.

Support corporate legal and governance activities, including preparation and review of Board
Resolutions, authority letters, court authorisations, digital-signatory authorisations and other
corporate/legal documentation. Maintain legal records, contract trackers and matter-wise
documentation and monitor contractual and legal obligations for timely action.

SENIOR ADVOCATE SACHIN P. SHETYE, MUMBAI HIGH COURT

Legal Associate | Apr 2020 – Feb 2024*

Handled legal matters across Maharashtra, Goa and Delhi, covering commercial, civil, criminal, RERA,
IPR and non-litigation matters. Drafted and reviewed commercial agreements, legal notices, pleadings,
conveyancing documents, applications, replies and other legal documentation, while assisting clients
and senior counsel in identifying legal risks and developing appropriate legal and commercial
strategies.

Managed litigation proceedings, client coordination, legal research, case preparation and court-
related documentation. Drafted and reviewed real-estate documentation including Agreements for
Sale, Deeds of Apartment, Supplementary Deeds, Correction Deeds, Possession Documents and Work



Orders. Prepared legal opinions, case notes and research for senior counsel and clients and
coordinated with advocates, consultants and other stakeholders. Also supported and guided junior
legal associates and paralegals.

LAWSPADES, PUNE
Legal Associate – USA Medical Insurance Arbitration | Jan 2020 – Mar 2020

Worked on medico-legal documentation, contract-related matters and USA medical insurance
arbitration assignments, including documentation review, legal research and matter preparation.

ADV. PRANAV NIVREKAR, MUMBAI
Junior Advocate | Jul 2019 – Jan 2020

Assisted in Rent Court proceedings and civil, criminal, family court and IPR matters. Prepared legal
documentation, research, applications and court-related filings and assisted with case preparation,
client coordination and court proceedings.

SELECTED CONTRACT & LEGAL EXPOSURE

Commercial Contracts: Service Agreements | Vendor Agreements | Distributor Agreements | OEM
Agreements | Consulting Agreements | Customer Agreements | Rental/Reagent Agreements

Technology & IP: NDAs | Confidentiality Agreements | Technology Transfer Agreements | IP
Protection | Trademark Matters

Commercial & Tender: Tripartite Agreements | Tender Contracts | Government Procurement |
Distributor Arrangements | Instrument/Equipment Placement | Contract Amendments

Contract Risk: Indemnity | Limitation of Liability | Termination | Penalties | Liquidated Damages |
Warranties | Payment Terms | Performance Obligations | Dispute Resolution | Governing Law |
Jurisdiction

Litigation & Advisory: Consumer Matters | Labour & Employment | Section 138 NI Act | Civil &
Criminal Litigation | Contractual Disputes | RERA | IPR | Legal Notices | Regulatory Matters | External
Counsel Management

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

 Diploma – US Contract Law & Paralegal Studies, LawSikho | July 2026 – Pursuing
 Master Course in Contract Law & Contract Management**, Udemy | Completed
 LL.M. – International Law, Ajeenkya DY Patil University, Pune | 2019
 B.L.S. LL.B., Rizvi Law College, University of Mumbai | 2018
 Post Graduate Diploma in Cyber Law, Asian School of Cyber Laws | 2015 | 76%
 Diploma in Cyber Law, Asian School of Cyber Laws | 2013 | 62%
 All India Bar Council Examination, Cleared | 2020
 Sanad – Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa | 2019

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS

Contract & Legal Contract Drafting | Contract Review | Contract Negotiation | Contract Lifecycle
Management | Commercial Contracting | Legal Research | Legal Opinions | Legal Risk Assessment |
Compliance | Legal Documentation | Due Diligence

Business: Commercial Negotiation | Stakeholder Management | Business Advisory | Vendor &
Distributor Management | Risk Mitigation | Problem Solving | Cross-functional Coordination |
Communication



Litigation & Corporate: Litigation Management | Dispute Resolution | Legal Notices | Court
Coordination | External Counsel Management | Board Resolutions | Corporate Authorisations

LANGUAGES & ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Languages: English | Hindi | Marathi | Urdu | Awadhi | Gujarati

Preferred Locations: Mumbai | Navi Mumbai | Thane
